inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read a revisioned bounded input section, descriptor or explicitly requested JSON-pointer page without editing or solving.

pointer.description: Absolute escaped JSON Pointer within the selected section; empty pointer addresses project root only.

expectedRevision.description: Exact SHA-256 revision returned by the relevant inspection; never infer a revision.

limit.description: Object pages additionally reject limit above 50; arrays and explicit string pages allow 200.

limitations: Response is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Nested arrays/objects and long strings are described with hashes and counts rather than recursively emitted.
Object entries are key-sorted. Explicit pointer requests may read bounded string pages, including source data; no root source payload is dumped.
Compare returned revision or provide expectedRevision across pages. SHA-256 authenticates bytes/JSON identity, not provenance correctness or physical accuracy.
